atoms.text: Mr Waddle makes the journey to Africa. Will you take him around Africa?

instruction.text: Can you point out Africa to Mr Waddle on the map?

feedback.end: Did you know that there are over 50 different countries in Africa?

instruction.text: Mr Waddle explores some African cities. Select the images of cities he might visit.

feedback.wrong1: This is the tallest mountain in the world. It is in Asia.
feedback.wrong2: This is the largest rainforest in the world. It is in South America.

instruction.text: Mr Waddle wants to explore some African nature. Select the images of natural African landscapes.

hint.text: Africa is the hottest and driest continent on Earth. It is home to the huge Sahara Desert and many open grasslands.

feedback.wrong: This is a glacier in South America. A glacier is a large, moving body of ice.

instruction.text: Mr Waddle visits the famous Pyramids of Giza in Egypt. Find the highest point of the pyramid in the image to tell him a fun fact.

feedback.end: The pyramids were built around 4,500 years ago! They were tombs for Egyptian kings and queens called pharaohs.

instruction.text: Mr Waddle wants to see all the different kinds of African wildlife. Drag the images to the correct group.

hint.text: Because Africa is very large, it has dry, grassy plains as well as wet, leafy rainforests.
